label: A lump of coal off a friend: a hard thud on a coat, soot puffing, the lump breaking
how: A fist of coal thrown hard into a crewmate: a blunt thud on a heavy coat (a short slap of cloth and a soft weight, nothing fleshy), a puff of soot off the coat, and the lump breaking as it drops off them, its pieces clinking bright and glassy on the way down. Three throws.
